verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a document-parsing/extraction platform that exposes its own capabilities as an MCP server for other agents to call (llamaparse-docs-8, llamaparse-probe-rt-1) — the reverse relationship. There is no evidence, nor is it a natural fit for this product category, that LlamaParse itself acts as an MCP client/host that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools; this axis is about agent-hosting behavior which doesn't apply to a document-processing API/service.
